# Lenis integration reference

A DSH reference Skill for planning or reviewing integrations of [darkroomengineering/lenis](https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis). It contains original guidance only; no upstream code, documentation, examples, or images are copied.

## Automatic selection

Automatic selection is off by default for each Agent. Use `/dsh-lenis-tonulls on` and `/dsh-lenis-tonulls off`; direct Skill invocation remains available.
